rationale: Work-request loading, scheduling, status, and productivity tracking are conventional dispatch functions, but estimating job duration and prioritizing requests have no described method and leave an uncertain prediction/decision function.
evidence_spans: loading and prioritizing work requests, estimating the time required to do jobs, and scheduling the work.
provides on-line status tracking of work requests and helps track productivity of a work center for management use.
conflict_response: The conventional dispatch context does not establish that prioritization or duration estimates are rule-based, so I do not infer a deterministic implementation. Since estimation is potentially predictive and its method is unstated, I preserve non_ai as best-supported but weaken and force the binary decision.
